text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#INC-2026-4572 -> service: embed-api-canary | symptom: 5xx spike from model-worker | severity: P1 | link: https://pagerduty.local/incidents/INC-2026-4572
pagerduty-bot: Paging samir (sre-oncall) via PagerDuty escalation policy (primary). If not acknowledged in 2m will escalate to ashley.
samir: acked via PD. joining bridge now. reading initial metrics — thanks.
ashley: oncalldev here, standing by if it escalates. any context on which SKU/region?
samir: looks like canary deploy pushed last hour to us-west1, model variant quant-v2. Error rate jumped ~18% for embed calls to the canary pool. p50 latency up a bit. will dump logs.
maria: tagging perf dash: https://grafana/redwood/embed-api-canary -> error pct chart shows 5xx spike starting 60m ago aligning w/ deploy.
ryan: noticed worker OOM traces in node logs earlier, but the stack traces point to a quant kernel memory alloc path. sharing recent log tail:```
[2026-03-14T20:12:31Z] model-worker-7f8c: ERROR allocate_kv_cache: failed to alloc 2097152 bytes
[2026-03-14T20:12:31Z] model-worker-7f8c: WARN falling back to small-chunk allocator
[2026-03-14T20:12:32Z] model-worker-7f8c: ERROR inference_request: failed with code 502: upstream failure
```
ashley: that matches a kernel change we rolled in the quant runtime in canary image edge/quant-v2:tag-2026-03-14.
samir: quick healthcheck commands I ran:```
curl -sS https://embed-canary.us-west1.internal/health | jq .
# returned: {"status":"degraded","replicas":3,"ready":1}
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=embed-canary -o wide
```
ashley: seeing pods restart counts high on 2 of 3 replicas. suspect kernel path causing mem fragmentation leading to OOMs and 502s.
ryan: customer impact estimate from telemetry: approx 6% of overall embedding requests are routed to canary pool; error rate there is 18% so ~1.1% of total customers experiencing errors, but some high-throughput partners (batch ingest jobs) hit the canary and are seeing retries/backpressure.
dave: can we mitigate without rollback? e.g., scale canary up or disable quant path?
samir: scaling won't help if allocator fails deterministically. there is a knob in runtime to force scalar fallback (env USE_LEGACY_ALLOC=true) — could flip for canary but that defeats test. prefer rollback to stable image.
maria: ops-runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/embed-canary-failures -> recommends rollback if kernel alloc errors observed.
ashley: I'll prepare a rollback. calling out procedure: 1) pause traffic routing to canary (traffic-split svc) 2) deploy previous stable image tag-2026-03-10 to canary (so tests remain) 3) monitor error rate and latency for 15m 4) if green, promote stable.
samir: assigning steps: ashley does the rollback, i'll monitor logs and PD statuses, ryan will coordinate customer comms if needed, maria run dashboards.
ashley: executing:```
# scale down canary traffic
curl -X POST https://traffic-router.internal/api/splits \ 
 -d '{"service":"embed","canary_percentage":0}'
# deploy stable to canary
gcloud run deploy embed-api-canary --image gcr.io/redwood/embed:tag-2026-03-10 --region us-west1 --quiet
```
samir: confirmed PD shows ack by samir. starting a 5m watch window for escalation.
pagerduty-bot: PD update: INC-2026-4572 acknowledged by samir at 2026-03-14T20:15:02Z. next escalation scheduled at +2m if no progress noted.
ashley: stable image now rolled to canary. pods converging. health endpoint now:```
{"status":"healthy","replicas":3,"ready":3}```
maria: grafana shows error rate dropping in canary from 18% -> 1.2% over the last 3m. p50 latency returning to baseline.
ryan: customer-impact note: we throttled canary traffic so immediate customer-facing effects are reduced. I will draft a short CS message for affected partners and check if any retries caused downstream rate-limited queues.
dave: any logs of 5xx for embedding-batches queued?
samir: saw backlog clear shortly after rollback. forwarding a couple of sample traces to incident thread for postmortem: trace ids: tr-9a2c, tr-9a3f.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-4572 status: mitigated (manual rollback) at 2026-03-14T20:22:10Z. PD status set to resolved candidate pending post-incident review.
ashley: will keep monitoring for 30m and then mark resolved if stable. adding follow-ups: - revert the quant kernel change from canary image branch and open PR to add extra alloc checks - test on staging with smaller chunk sizes - add a runtime feature flag to gate new allocator.
maria: adding notes to postmortem board and assigning to nearest release cycle.
ryan: customer comms: emailed affected partners with summary and apology, offered to rerun failed batches. awaiting replies.
samir: closing loop with oncall: great quick rollback. next: postmortem and mitigation tasks assigned. closing PD incident after we confirm stable for 30m. :thumbsup:
